🤖 Claude Get key ↗ ✓ Saved
✶ Gemini Get key ↗ ✓ Saved
⚡ Groq Get key ↗ ✓ Saved
How to get a free API key →
  1. Groq (free, fastest): Visit console.groq.com/keys → sign in with Google → Create API key → copy it
  2. Gemini (free): Visit aistudio.google.com/app/apikey → Create API key → copy it
  3. Claude (paid): Visit console.anthropic.com/settings/keys → Create key → copy it
  4. Paste the key in the Your Personal API Keys section above → it saves automatically in your browser
  5. Privacy: Keys are stored only in your browser (localStorage). They are sent only to the AI provider's API — never stored on Shuddhi QA servers.
Provider comparison →
Claude (Anthropic) — Best quality for complex QA reasoning. Paid. Used last to protect budget.
Gemini 2.5 Flash (Google) — Free: 15 req/min, 1,500 req/day. Best quality output. Used for large documents Groq cannot handle.
Groq/Llama — Free: 30 req/min, 14,400 req/day. Default first choice — handles most generations at ₹0. Table format fidelity is lower than Claude/Gemini; output is auto-normalised where possible.
Fallback order: Groq → Gemini → Claude (cost-optimised)

Azure DevOps Integration
❓ How to create PAT
Enter your ADO Organisation URL and PAT to push test cases directly to ADO Test Plans. Saved in your browser — never sent to our servers.
⏳
Enter your details below to connect
Organisation URL *
Format: https://dev.azure.com/OrganisationName
Personal Access Token (PAT) *
Required scopes: Test Management: Read & Write + Work Items: Read & Write
Default Project (optional)
Pre-fills the project dropdown when pushing test cases
🗑 Clear saved ADO settings
How to create an ADO PAT →
  1. Open Azure DevOps → click your Profile avatar (top right)
  2. Click User Settings → Personal Access Tokens
  3. Click New Token — set Name, Organisation, Expiry
  4. Scopes: Test Management: Read & Write + Work Items: Read & Write + Project and Team: Read
  5. Click Create → Copy the token immediately
  6. Paste it in the PAT field above → click Save Settings

🔒 Jira credentials are saved in your browser localStorage only.
How to set up Jira integration →
  1. Go to id.atlassian.com/manage/api-tokens → Create API Token
  2. Copy the token (starts with ATATT3x…)
  3. Enter your Jira Base URL, email, and token above
  4. Click Test to verify the connection
  5. Once connected, use the Jira Ticket ID field in the main form
  6. Enter your Jira details in Settings → Jira tab

🆕 What's New in v9.43
v9.43 — Domain Intelligence + Language Fix + Firebase Auth
🏢 Industry Domain Intelligence — select Insurance, Banking, HR, ERP, Retail or Healthcare for domain-aware test cases with business risk tagging
🌐 Multi-language fix — Deutsch, Español, Français and Português (BR) now generate correctly; output language injected into AI prompt
🔔 Notification renderer fix — resolved pre-existing JS syntax error in notification panel hover styles
💳 Google Billing Live Sync — No verification warning. Uses safe cloud-billing.readonly scope only.
📊 4-way spending detection — Tries 4 API endpoints in sequence to fetch the live ₹ spend figure.
🔗 Console deep-links — Anthropic ↗, Google Cloud ↗ and Groq ↗ buttons in Usage & Cost.
🔄 Auto-refresh — Billing data refreshes on tab-open and every 5 minutes. Shows last-updated timestamp.
🐛 Bug fix — Fixed "" is not a function crash when opening Usage & Cost tab.
